description:
About the company
 Our client is a technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Lead a research agenda in offline reinforcement learning, taking ideas from initial question through to shared findings. The position prizes scientific depth and judgment over engineering breadth, and pairs you with a more established colleague while leaving space to chart your own path.
 What you'll do
 - Drive offline reinforcement learning research from start to finish, including choosing which questions to pursue and communicating the outcomes.
 - Raise the performance of learned control policies on internal evaluation suites and build on earlier policy work.
 - Train models on large, uneven-quality collections of data where feedback is scarce, applying several value estimation approaches.
 - Investigate model-based methods and learned environment models for continuous control.
 - Examine what keeps reinforcement learning training stable as data, compute and model scale increase.
 - Design rigorous experiments with dependable baselines and watch findings get tested on physical robots.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Background in reinforcement learning research, in a research or applied scientist capacity, connected to generative visual models.
 - A record of papers accepted at leading machine learning or robotics venues.
 - Depth in core and offline reinforcement learning topics, such as value estimation, goal-directed learning, policy design and training stability at scale.
 - Familiarity with model-based methods for continuous control or with multimodal value estimation.
 - An advanced degree (PhD or master's) in machine learning, computer science or an adjacent area, centered on reinforcement learning.
 - Ability to work on-site six days a week.
 Bonus points
 - Prior exposure to visual generative models applied to robotics.
 - Time spent doing research at a top-tier AI organization.
 - Contributions to publicly shared reinforcement learning codebases.
 - Experience with large-scale simulation, sim-to-real transfer or robotics, including JAX.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 350,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site, 6 days per week in office
 - Full-time
